Name: More Rings
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Adds new rings with special effects.
Description:
**More Rings** adds new rings with special effects.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io), [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿, and [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
This mod adds seven new rings:

*   **﻿Quality+ Ring:** 12.5% chance of higher crop quality.****

*   **Refreshing Ring:** restore stamina passively.

*   **Ring of Diamond Booze:** negate the tipsy effect from alcohol.

*   **Ring of Far Reaching:** use tools at a distance.

*   **Ring of Regeneration:** regenerate health passively.

*   **Ring of True Sight:** see what's in mining nodes and artifact spots.

*   **Ring of Wide Nets:** 50% larger fishing bar.
See [the README for more info](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/MoreRings#use)﻿, including how to obtain them.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

Known mod conflicts:

*   Level Extender may cause Ring of Wide Nets to do nothing, since it overrides the fishing logic.
**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/MoreRings/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
